import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas and convert)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Standardize sex column: convert all to lowercase, leave missing as NaN
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.lower()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace('nan', pd.NA)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
